premises.text: A single piece of personal identifiable information can cost an organization $186 per record
premises.evidence_span: A single piece of personal identifiable information, known as PII, can cost an organization $186 per record.

premises.text: Existing cyber solutions make humans responsible for security actions, which can hinder productivity
premises.evidence_span: Existing cyber solutions make humans responsible for security actions, when in reality security actions often get in the way of getting a job done.

premises.text: Phalanx reduces the attack surface by securing unused files while allowing access to used files
premises.evidence_span: If you have 1,000 files on your computer and you're only using one, then you expose that one while 999 files are secured by Phalanx.

premises.text: Phalanx is deployable in less than a day and requires zero weekly maintenance
premises.evidence_span: Phalanx is an identity-based solution that leverages automation, and that means we're deployable in less than a day and requires zero weekly maintenance.

premises.text: Phalanx provides a digital map of every file across existing workspaces
premises.evidence_span: Phalanx provides a digital map of every file across every existing workspace.

premises.text: Phalanx reduces cyber risk exposure for customers in financial services and government contracting sectors
premises.evidence_span: We've reduced the cyber risk exposure of our customers in the financial services and government contracting sectors by over 60%.

premises.text: Phalanx enables businesses by securing their data and allowing them to quantify cyber risk
premises.evidence_span: not only are we securing their data, we're actually enabling their businesses.

value.text: Organizations can secure their data while maintaining productivity
value.evidence_span: Phalanx's mission focuses on the core problem that users have to make security decisions, and they pit that against productivity decisions.
